verifiedCurrentBaseline: Exactly one published lesson currently exists in each of the three active core tracks; this roadmap does not imply those future lessons exist in the app yet.
principles: Keep the current three-track scope: Accounting/IFRS with a light Irish statutory layer, Irish Payroll, and professional English.
Build usable professional judgement and communication, not a catalogue of standards or tax rates.
Each future Golden Lesson should reuse the same architecture: written core, examples, local practice, case, fixed checkpoint, Professor reference, evaluator criteria, revision hooks and source scope.
Current-rate or date-sensitive payroll content must identify its source/review date and must not be inferred from fictional examples.
English lessons should train workplace comprehension and response, not claim a CEFR level from one exercise.
Do not add ACCA, Spanish or Brazilian Tax Reform to the active curriculum in this phase; keep the architecture adaptable for later expansion.

finance.courseIntent: Manager-level Accounting/IFRS judgement with practical reporting, business-partnering and a light Ireland/FRS 102 bridge.

currentReference.title: IFRS 18, Group Reporting & Irish Statutory Accounts

next.title: Revenue judgement: contracts, performance obligations & cut-off
next.core: IFRS 15 five-step model, contract changes, timing and month-end evidence
next.irelandLayer: Contrast high-level IFRS treatment with the 2026 FRS 102 revenue model only where the local reporting basis requires it
next.managerOutput: Explain a revenue cut-off judgement and the evidence needed before close

next.title: Leases: recognition, close controls & local-framework differences
next.core: IFRS 16 lessee mechanics, modifications, judgement and close controls
next.irelandLayer: FRS 102 Periodic Review 2024 lease changes effective principally from 1 January 2026 for applicable entities
next.managerOutput: Reconcile lease movements and explain a reporting-basis difference without mixing frameworks

next.title: Cash flow & working capital: from ledger movement to management story
next.core: IAS 7 cash-flow classification, non-cash items and reconciliation logic
next.irelandLayer: Keep statutory-format distinctions scoped to the entity's actual reporting basis
next.managerOutput: Turn AR/AP/inventory movements into a defensible cash narrative

next.title: Financial instruments & receivables: classification, ECL and evidence
next.core: IFRS 9 classification concepts and expected-credit-loss judgement for receivables
next.irelandLayer: Flag framework-specific simplifications/differences rather than copying IFRS into FRS 102 automatically
next.managerOutput: Challenge an allowance movement and document the evidence supporting it

next.title: Consolidation & group reporting: control, eliminations and package quality
next.core: IFRS 10 control logic, group eliminations, intercompany mismatches and reporting-package controls
next.irelandLayer: Separate group IFRS reporting from local statutory accounts and eligibility decisions
next.managerOutput: Diagnose a consolidation mismatch and assign a controlled resolution

next.title: Income tax accounting: current/deferred tax and reporting bridge
next.core: IAS 12 current/deferred tax concepts, temporary differences and evidence
next.irelandLayer: Use Irish statutory/tax facts only as sourced case inputs; never infer tax-law treatment from IAS 12
next.managerOutput: Explain a deferred-tax movement to a CFO without confusing accounting with the tax return

next.title: FRS 102 2026 bridge for an Irish finance manager
next.core: Choose the reporting basis first; identify the major current FRS 102 changes and controls
next.irelandLayer: Republic of Ireland application, Periodic Review 2024 and adapted-format changes where relevant
next.managerOutput: Build a short IFRS-group vs local-statutory gap register

payroll.courseIntent: Operational Irish payroll competence: accurate inputs, submissions, controls, employee communication and evidence-based corrections.

next.title: RPN, pay date, Employment ID & payroll submission workflow
next.core: Correct RPN, payment date, identifiers and submission sequence
next.managerOutput: Trace a payroll from approved input to Revenue submission and identify the control point that failed

next.title: Pay bases, pensions & statutory deductions without one-base thinking
next.core: Gross pay, Income Tax pay, USC treatment, employee/employer contributions and pension distinctions
next.managerOutput: Reconcile supplied bases and explain why one deduction base cannot be copied to every charge

next.title: Benefits, notional pay & employer-paid items
next.core: Taxable benefits, medical insurance, share remuneration and employer retirement contributions in payroll reporting
next.managerOutput: Classify a benefit input and document what must be confirmed before payroll

next.title: Corrections, overpayments & payroll reconciliation
next.core: Correction workflow, overpayments, audit trail and difference analysis
next.managerOutput: Separate the confirmed variance from its cause and prepare a reviewed correction plan

next.title: Starters, leavers & post-cessation payments
next.core: Commencement/cessation data, final submission, original Employment ID and post-cessation handling
next.managerOutput: Process a leaver case without losing the employment identity or inventing tax treatment

next.title: Employee queries: explain a net-pay change safely and clearly
next.core: Evidence gathering, privacy, escalation and plain-English payroll communication
next.managerOutput: Answer an employee while distinguishing known facts, working hypothesis and next check

next.title: Payroll controls & month-end handoff to Finance
next.core: Payroll register, payment file, Revenue submission, GL journal, exception review and sign-off
next.managerOutput: Run a compact payroll-to-GL reconciliation and surface unresolved exceptions

next.title: Clarify, check understanding & handle meetings

next.title: Explain numbers and variances to a stakeholder

next.title: Professional emails: concise requests, explanations & follow-up
next.core: Organisation, tone, enquiries, arrangements and proofreading

next.title: Present a recommendation and answer follow-up questions

next.title: Disagree, challenge and resolve conflict professionally

buildOrder: Finish real acceptance of the three current reference Golden Lessons before calling them end-to-end accepted.
In parallel, author P1 lesson specifications and source maps without publishing them to the DB.
Build the next P1 written foundation in each track, then attach local practice/evaluator references using the existing shared architecture.
Publish new lessons to the database only after content/source QA and a separate deployment decision.
